definitions.explanation: To demolish an old or damaged building and construct a new one in its place.

definitions.gloss: to reorganize; to restore; to get back on track
definitions.explanation: To rebuild something abstract such as a business, relationship, health, or life after a setback. Often written as 立て直す for this figurative sense.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れた→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{建|た}て{直|なお}す⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are plans to rebuild the school that was destroyed in the earthquake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代|だい}→〜代：28331_dai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{建|た}て{直|なお}し→建て直し：22559_tatenaoshi⟧た⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{築|ちく}→築：29014_chiku⟧⟦{五十|ごじゅう}→五十：00930_gojuu⟧⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: This house, rebuilt in my grandfather's generation, is now fifty years old.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{建|た}て{直|なお}す。
⟦{体調|たいちょう}→体調：04644_taichou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{建|た}て{直|なお}し→建て直し：22559_tatenaoshi⟧て⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{復帰|ふっき}する→復帰する：25395_fukkisuru⟧。
examples.english: I'll return after getting my health back on track.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤字|あかじ}→赤字：04712_akaji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いていた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{建|た}て{直|なお}すこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: The company had been running deficits, but under the new president they managed to turn it around.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Godan verb (す ending, conjugates as s-row: ⟦{建|た}て→建つ：12544_tatsu⟧⟦{直|なお}さない→直す：00869_naosu⟧, ⟦{建|た}て{直|なお}し→建て直し：22559_tatenaoshi⟧ます). Transitive — takes a direct object marked with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧.

WRITING:
Sense 1 (physical rebuilding) uses {建|た}て{直|なお}す. Sense 2 (figurative rebuilding) is often written ⟦{立|た}て{直|なお}す→立て直す：03113_tatenaosu⟧, though the two are sometimes used interchangeably.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{建|た}て{直|なお}す (to rebuild a house)
- ⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{建|た}て{直|なお}す (to restructure a business)
- ⟦{体調|たいちょう}→体調：04644_taichou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{建|た}て{直|なお}す (to restore one's health)
- ⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{建|た}て{直|なお}す (to get one's life back together)
